description: Register one insurance producer (individual or business) for NIPR license renewals. Only licensee_type and npn are required; licensing_check_readiness says what is still missing. Never send SSNs, FEINs or other tax ids, dates of birth, passwords (NIPR or any other), card or bank numbers: the API refuses them, and you must not ask the user for them. Sandbox (the default) files nothing. Servicing: needs an API key with the licensing scopes.

attestation.description: The licensee's background answers: { questionSetVersion, answers: { <slug>: { answer: "yes"|"no", detail? } } }. Send with attestation_signed.

external_ref.description: The caller's own id for this licensee
